timestamp_semantics: Monotonic logical append time after the Campaign275 final validated state; not a market-data or host-wall-clock measurement.
objective: Freeze a finite priority-ordered catalog of economically independent issuer external-state mechanisms before any Campaign276 targeted prior-definition or source-frontier search.

catalog_selection_rule.selection_method: After this file is immutable, inspect complete local terminal-definition and source-frontier evidence in catalog priority order. Select the first route that is economically independent, has a lawful and auditable 2019-2023 point-in-time issuer identity, availability, revision and complete-market denominator contract, and is not a same-mechanism source, entity-role, jurisdiction, formula, field, window or cohort rescue. Close every sibling and parameter variant. If no route survives, terminalize Campaign276 before formula, direction, provider, fields, source rows, factor values, comparison values, prices or returns.

concept_catalog.economic_state: Issuer demand pipeline and delivery conversion reflected in public procurement tender, bid, award, acceptance, payment, cancellation and dispute lifecycle records.
Issuer policy support and project execution reflected in grant or subsidy application, approval, disbursement, milestone, clawback and repayment lifecycle records.
Issuer product quality and liability risk reflected in recall, stop-sale, corrective-action, adverse-safety, completion and closure lifecycle records.
Issuer technology monetization and control reflected in patent, trademark or copyright license, assignment, opposition, invalidation, expiry and release lifecycle records.
Issuer physical capacity formation and retirement reflected in facility construction permit, inspection, commissioning, occupancy, suspension and closure lifecycle records.
Issuer logistics and mobile-asset utilization reflected in fleet vehicle registration, inspection, permit, active-use, retirement and transfer lifecycle records.
Issuer service quality and customer-friction state reflected in public complaint, mediation, regulator referral, remedy, withdrawal and closure lifecycle records.
